notes.title: Playtesters, Localizers & Supporters
notes.content:
[b]Shroud of Gloom[/b] is currently in development, and you can now contribute to the game and get your name in the credits! This is a chance to play a part in shaping Shroud of Gloom before its official release.

[h2]Playtesters[/h2]
Try the game early, give feedback, and help us create a better experience.
[url=https://forms.gle/HCvt33Q54aaqsNNx7]Apply as a Playtester[/url]

[h2]Localizers[/h2]
Translate the game into different languages to ensure players worldwide can enjoy the horror.
[url=https://forms.gle/HuAMnvuLBgw5jYJSA]Apply as a Localizer[/url]

[h2]Supporters[/h2]
Last but not least, people who support the development over at Twitch will also be credited.
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/madchirpy]Watch the development on Twitch[/url]

Thank you very much for your consideration in contributing to the game - but don't forget, the most important thing you can do to help out is to [b]Wishlist & Follow[/b] the game on Steam!

[previewyoutube=ftjfYlZq3y4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome to Shroud of Gloom
notes.content:
[h2]Watch the Development[/h2]
Follow the development [url=https://www.twitch.tv/madchirpy]live on Twitch[/url]: I stream the creation of the game, from coding and pixel art to designing rooms and puzzles. Stop by, ask questions, and get a behind-the-scenes look at how horror comes to life.

You can also join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/cFFBq6g]Discord server[/url] if you want to connect with the community!

[h2]About the Game[/h2]
[b]Shroud of Gloom[/b] is an upcoming point-and-click horror game where you solve puzzles and uncover secrets with nothing but a flickering flashlight to guide your way.

[b]Wishlist now[/b] to be notified when the demo drops!

This game was originally developed for the GDFG's Monthly Game Jam #36, where it ranked 1st in every category, now coming to Steam as a longer and improved version!

The darkness is closing in. Are you ready? 🔦
